name: Gaslight
description:
[Wiki Page](https://wiki.roll20.net/Script:Gaslight)

Per-player map perception. Split players onto individual copies of a page with tokens synchronized via Anchor. Each player can see different things (different token art, names, hidden tokens) while token movement stays consistent across all copies.

Use cases: illusions, shapechangers, stealth/perception, madness/hallucinations, secrets.

**v2.4.0 - New features:**
- GL-SCRATCH pageFolder (Latest sandbox v1.5+): scratch pages now live in a dedicated ' + SCRATCH_NAME + ' folder to stay out of sight. Any page in the folder is treated as a scratch page — just drop blank pages in.
- In-use scratch copies are moved next to the master page during `quick`, and returned to the ' + SCRATCH_NAME + ' folder on merge.
- On startup the ' + SCRATCH_NAME + ' folder is auto-created and any loose ' + SCRATCH_NAME + '-named pages are tucked into it.
- Empty pages added to the folder are auto-named ' + SCRATCH_NAME + '; a non-empty page dropped in by mistake is ejected back to where it came from with a heads-up to the GM.
- Reminder to open newly-added scratch pages once (Roll20 only initializes a page when first viewed; `quick` can\'t clone onto an unopened page).
- v1.0 (Legacy) sandbox is unaffected — the flat, name-based ' + SCRATCH_NAME + ' behavior still applies.

Commands:
- `!gaslight setup [group] [players...]` -- Quick-configure group from duplicate pages
- `!gaslight quick [group] [players...]` -- Configure + split using page copies and scratch pages
- `!gaslight split <group> [--force]` -- Activate a prepared group
- `!gaslight merge [group]` -- End a split; players return to their previous split (or banner)
- `!gaslight merge-all` -- End all active splits (pop the whole stack)
- `!gaslight test <group>` -- Dry-run linking resolution
- `!gaslight status` -- Show configured groups, active splits, linked token counts
- `!gaslight link [<name>|new] [ids...]` -- Set gaslight_link on selected + explicit tokens
- `!gaslight unlink [ids...|--group <g>]` -- Remove gaslight_link from tokens
- `!gaslight sync [--default] [all|reset|<props...>]` -- Show or modify sync config for selected tokens
- `!gaslight desync [--default] <props...|all>` -- Exclude properties from sync on selected tokens
- `!gaslight group <group> <player|GM>` -- Assign current page to a group
- `!gaslight ungroup <group> <player|GM|--all>` -- Remove page from group
- `!gaslight stage [--default on|off] [players...]` -- Propagate selected tokens to player pages and link
- `!gaslight view [player|master|off]` -- Show or switch relay view target
- `!gaslight relay <views...> <command>` -- Relay a command to specific views (select tokens first)
- `!gaslight config [relay-add|relay-remove|relay-list] [commands...]` -- Configure auto-relay command list
- `!gaslight eval [--dry-run] [--all|<handout>]` -- Evaluate script pins
- `!gaslight var [--silent] --set|--get|--del <name> [value]` -- Get/set/delete gl_* variables on selected tokens
- `!gaslight init [sync|trim]` -- Sync initiative turn order with the HUD
- `!gaslight hud [<element>] [on|off|reset]` -- Toggle HUD elements
